# TESCA Spoken English & Visa Consultancy

> TESCA is Gujarat's premier English language training institute and study abroad visa consultancy, established in 2005 in Surat, Gujarat, India. TESCA specializes in Spoken English (Basic & Advanced), IELTS Preparation (Academic & General), PTE Academic Coaching, Interview Preparation, and Overseas Education Consulting.

## Key Facts & Institutional Credentials
- **Founded:** 2005 (20+ years of educational excellence)
- **Students Trained:** 5,000+ successful alumni
- **Success Rate:** 95% score achievement rate
- **Trainers:** Cambridge-certified (CELTA, DELTA, TESOL) with 10–18 years of professional experience
- **Learning Modes:** Online Live Interactive Classes (worldwide access), Offline Campus Classrooms, and Hybrid Learning
- **Main Contact:** +91 84888 05888 | +91 99250 60609 | tescavisaconsultancy87@gmail.com

## Offered Courses & Training Programs

### 1. Spoken English Basic
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/courses/spoken-english-basic
- **Duration:** 3 Months
- **Target Audience:** Complete beginners, homemakers, Gujarati/Hindi medium students, and job seekers wanting to speak English without hesitation.
- **Key Modules:** Grammar foundations, 500+ everyday vocabulary words, sentence formation frameworks, phonics, accent correction, and guided conversation practice.
- **Pricing:** ₹7,999 (Discounted from ₹11,999)

### 2. Spoken English Advanced
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/courses/spoken-english-advanced
- **Duration:** 4 Months
- **Target Audience:** Working professionals, managers, business owners, and graduates seeking fluent conversational English, corporate presentation skills, and public speaking.
- **Key Modules:** Corporate communication, email drafting, public speaking & debate, filler-free speaking, accent neutralization, and executive vocabulary.
- **Pricing:** ₹12,999 (Discounted from ₹17,999)

### 3. IELTS Preparation (Academic & General Training)
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/courses/ielts-preparation
- **Duration:** 6 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Students pursuing higher education abroad (UK, Canada, USA, Australia, Germany) and professionals seeking Permanent Residency (PR).
- **Key Modules:** Comprehensive training for all 4 test modules (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking), 15+ full-length mock tests, band 7.5+ strategies, line-by-line essay evaluations.
- **Pricing:** ₹9,999 (Discounted from ₹14,999)

### 4. PTE Academic Preparation
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/courses/pte-preparation
- **Duration:** 5 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Aspirants looking for computer-based English proficiency testing for fast-track university admissions and immigration.
- **Key Modules:** AI-scored mock tests, speaking & writing templates, repeat sentence drills, describe image frameworks, speed reading tactics.
- **Pricing:** ₹8,999 (Discounted from ₹12,999)

### 5. Interview Preparation & Personality Development
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/courses/interview-preparation
- **Duration:** 4 Weeks
- **Target Audience:** Job seekers, college freshers, and professionals preparing for corporate HR interviews, campus placements, or visa embassy interviews.
- **Key Modules:** STAR method behavioral answers, mock interviews with video review, resume evaluation, body language and confidence coaching.
- **Pricing:** ₹5,999 (Discounted from ₹8,999)

## Study Abroad & Visa Consultancy Services
- **URL:** https://tesca.co/contact?topic=study-abroad
- **Destinations Covered:** Canada, United Kingdom (UK), United States (USA), Australia, Germany, and Europe.
- **Services Provided:** University selection, course shortlisting, SOP (Statement of Purpose) writing, visa documentation, financial file preparation, and mock visa embassy interviews.
- **Visa Success Rate:** 97% visa approval rate.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Knowledge Base)

### Does TESCA offer free demo classes?
Yes. TESCA provides a 100% free 45-minute live interactive demo class for all prospective students with no advance payment or obligation. You can book a free demo at https://tesca.co or message WhatsApp at +91 84888 05888.

### Are classes available both online and in-person?
Yes. Students can attend live interactive online sessions from anywhere globally via Zoom / Google Meet, or join in-person batches at any of the 4 campus branches in Surat (Sarthana, Mota Varachha, Hirabaug, Yogichowk).

### What batch timings are available?
Batches run Monday through Saturday with morning batches (7:00 AM to 11:00 AM), afternoon batches, and evening batches (5:00 PM to 8:30 PM), accommodating students, working professionals, and homemakers.
